en.tool.shpdxf.name: Cadastre shapefile to DXF converter
en.tool.shpdxf.summary: Upload the cadastre zip (parcel and building) and get DXF: the boundaries as lines, the vertices on their own.
en.tool.limit: Maximum size 7 MB. Use a Latin-letter file name.
en.tool.privacy: Files are not sent to a server. The conversion happens entirely in your browser.
en.tool.noZ: The file carries no Z values
en.tool.downloadHint: Upload an archive to enable the download.
en.tool.crsNote: Coordinates are not reprojected: the DXF keeps the original system.
en.tool.noticeLatin: Use a Latin-letter name for the zip file to avoid problems.
en.tool.noticeNoBuilding: No building layer was found. There are probably no buildings on the plot.
en.tool.noticeNoParcel: No parcel layer was found: the archive carries only the building layer.
en.tool.error.tooBig: The file is larger than 7 MB. For files this size write to geogeeksllc@gmail.com.
en.tool.error.noShp: No .shp file was found in the archive.
en.tool.error.layers: No parcel or building layer was found in the archive. A cadastre extract normally contains both.
en.tool.error.badShp: The .shp file is damaged or not a shapefile.
en.tool.error.noGeometry: No polygons or lines were found in the file.
en.tool.error.unsupported: That geometry type is not supported. Polygons or lines are needed.
en.tool.error.generic: The file could not be processed.
en.tool.how1: Put the parcel and building layers (.shp, .shx, .dbf, .prj) in one zip with a Latin name.
en.tool.how2: Upload the archive, up to 7 MB, choose the entity type and pay.
en.tool.how3: Get five DXF files: lines and vertices per layer, plus the combined _cad_code.
en.tool.notes: Inner holes become closed lines too, and each vertex is written once. Cadastre codes appear only in _cad_code, on their own layers.
en.tool.disclaimer: The conversion runs in your browser, on the files you upload. GeoGeeks LLC does not receive, store or control them, and accepts no responsibility for the accuracy of the result or for how it is used. Coordinates are not reprojected.
en.unlock.title: Payment
en.unlock.waiting: Request sent. The payment is checked by hand, so the answer comes within 30 minutes at most. Stay on this page or close it and come back: the code fills itself in.
en.unlock.slow: Confirmation is taking longer than it should. Write to geogeeksllc@gmail.com and the code will be issued by hand.
en.unlock.approved: Payment confirmed. The code has arrived.
en.unlock.rejected: The payment was not confirmed. Check the transfer or write to us.
en.unlock.noBot: Automatic confirmation is unavailable right now. Send the payment receipt and your number to geogeeksllc@gmail.com
en.unlock.alsoTelegram: Also receive the code on Telegram
en.unlock.note: When you pay with Idram, write your phone number in the payment note.
en.unlock.codeWaiting: The code has arrived and is held here. Upload the zip archive to start the download.
en.unlock.flow: Confirmed by hand, within 30 minutes. Any questions:
en.unlock.invalid: The code is wrong or has already been used.
en.unlock.rate: Too many attempts. Wait a few minutes.
en.unlock.network: Could not reach the server. Try again.
en.unlock.unlocked: Payment confirmed. The files are downloading.
